resources.string: Save front-camera photos the way they appear in the preview.
Play a sound when taking a photo.
Always on: the law in your region requires a shutter sound.
Keep focus locked on a tapped subject as it moves.
Show a 3×3 grid to help with composition.
Take normal photos with your phone\'s own HDR processing, where the phone shares it with other apps. Zoom, tap to focus and Night Auto are off while it is on.
Show a level line that turns yellow when the phone is straight.
Restore all camera settings to their defaults.
Flash, timer, aspect ratio and every option on this screen go back to their defaults. Your photos are not affected.
See what this phone\'s cameras support.

Camoron enhances the photo your camera actually captures. Results depend on your phone\'s camera hardware, and a minimum compatible camera is required. Enhancement does not recreate or generate scene content.
All processing happens on your phone. Your photos are never uploaded.
